about: Measured in the original Portal by tools/parity.mjs orig checks/oracle/fling-wall.json. Values are what the original did; tol is how far the port may be off. Notes say when a value is derived rather than read directly.

settings.sampler: getpos once per tick. It reports the client view of the eye position (cl_smooth 0 during runs), blended between ticks, so times are good to about a tick; rates, speeds and heights are medians or fits. One sample per tick checked by a free fall (0.135 units per tick squared = 600 u/s²).

wf100_exit_vx.note: original comes out ~1% slower than it went in, the port ~1% faster (one tick of gravity?)

wf100_eye5.note: the original flies 18 units lower (44 at the 100 drop) for the same portals; cause not known (exit placement or a forced duck), not modelled
